name: playwright-bdd-framework
description: Playwright automation framework with BDD, API, and a11y testing

scripts.test:all: npm run test:ui && npm run test:api && npm run test:a11y && npm run test:bdd
scripts.test:ui: cross-env ALLURE_SUITE=ui npx playwright test src/tests/ui/*.spec.js
scripts.test:api: cross-env ALLURE_SUITE=api npx playwright test src/tests/api/*.spec.js
scripts.test:a11y: cross-env ALLURE_SUITE=accessibility npx playwright test src/tests/accessibility/*.spec.js

author: Automation Engineer
